queries.description: Scan the validated silver table and aggregate its time range.
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rows, min(observed_at) AS first_observation, max(observed_at) AS last_observation FROM lakehouse.silver.weather_hourly

queries.description: Measure grouped weather aggregation by location.
queries.sql: SELECT location_name, count(*) AS observations, avg(temperature_2m) AS average_temperature FROM lakehouse.silver.weather_hourly GROUP BY location_name ORDER BY location_name

queries.description: Exercise the event-time partition predicate and ordered result path.
queries.sql: SELECT location_name, observed_at, temperature_2m FROM lakehouse.silver.weather_hourly WHERE observed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' ORDER BY observed_at, location_name LIMIT 100
